name: Tretinoin (Retinoic Acid) 0.05% Cream — 30g Tube
short: Tretinoin 0.05% cream — 30g tube. Topical retinoid indicated for acne and photoaging. Available with prescription verification at CMC Pharmacy Cabo.
description:
Tretinoin is the carboxylic acid form of vitamin A (retinoic acid) and the prototype topical retinoid. This presentation contains tretinoin 0.05% in a 30g tube. Tretinoin is indicated for the topical treatment of acne vulgaris and, with continued use, may help improve the appearance of fine wrinkles and sun-induced hyperpigmentation as part of a broader skincare program.

Tretinoin acts by normalizing keratinocyte differentiation, accelerating cell turnover, and reducing comedone formation. Application is typically once daily at night, beginning with lower frequency to allow tolerance to develop. Use sunscreen during the day. If irritation persists, consult your dermatologist or healthcare provider.

Available at CMC Pharmacy Cabo with bilingual service and fast hotel delivery throughout Cabo. Prescription Required. A valid medical prescription is needed to dispense this medication. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1).
